claims: No. 6 seed Notre Dame defeated No. 2 seed Vanderbilt 67-64 in the 2026 NCAA Women's Basketball Tournament Sweet 16.
Hannah Hidalgo set a new NCAA single-season steals record, surpassing 192.
Notre Dame advanced to the Elite Eight.
Notre Dame will face the winner of North Carolina-UConn in the Elite Eight.
Mikayla Blakes led Vanderbilt with 26 points and eight rebounds.
Notre Dame held off a fourth-quarter comeback by Vanderbilt.
Hannah Hidalgo grabbed key possessions in the final minute.
This victory marks a return to the Elite Eight for the Notre Dame Fighting Irish
